name: Siemens MS42 (BMW M52TU)

read_methods.notes: OBD and closed-case bench programming use K-line. Stock OBD reads omit part of the bootloader. Full-ROM access depends on a compatible RAM agent or the open-case C167 bootstrap route.

notes: Siemens DME for the BMW M52TU inline-6 (predecessor of MS43). Flash is an AM29F400BB (512 KiB). ms4x.net describes three CRC16 checksums (boot/program/calibration); OpenTune has no MS4x checksum module yet (checksum null).

bench.notes: Multi-source minimum: +12 V to X60001-7 and X60004-26, ground X60001-4. ms4x.net's bench recipe instead feeds X60001-1, -7 and -8, grounds X60001-4/5/6 and uses K-line X60001-3 (X60004-32 as fallback). Boot mode is board-level: the C167's pin 104 is grounded while powering up, then released (ms4x 'How to connect'); never write a 512 KiB OBD read back in boot mode - it erases the unit-specific bootloader keys.
bench.resistor_notes: K-line programming; CAN (X60004-36/37) is for development only per ms4x.

safety_note: Bench safety: use a current-limited bench supply (12-13.8 V, start with a low current limit) and a fuse in the +12 V lead; connect ground first. Confirm every pin with a multimeter on YOUR unit before applying power - ground pins should show continuity to each other (and usually the housing), and hardware revisions can differ from the sources. A CAN bus needs about 60 ohm between CAN-H and CAN-L (two 120 ohm terminations): add a 120 ohm resistor if neither the unit nor your interface terminates. Swapped CAN-H/CAN-L just gives timeouts; +12 V on a signal pin can destroy the unit.

obd.protocol: BMW DS2 over K-line (stock programming route).
obd.notes: Stock OBD programming writes the program and calibration regions. Its 512 KiB read omits part of the bootloader. BimmerStein documents full-ROM transfers using a temporary RAM agent on supported MS42 boot variants.

bench.how: For closed-case K-line programming, supply +12 V to X60001-7 and ignition X60004-26, ground X60001-4 and connect K-line at X60004-32. CAN is unused for this connection.

points.name: C167 bootstrap test pad
points.note: MS4X identifies this pad on the MS42 board. The processor data sheet identifies P0L.4 as the bootstrap input.

boot.reset_timing: Ground the pad before power-up. MS4X reports releasing it about ten seconds after power-up, before reading or writing.
boot.notes: MS4X documents this open-case route for a byte-for-byte flash backup.

security.notes: The cited programming guides do not establish whether a complete diagnostic read or a flash write requires security access. OpenTune ships no OEM key.
